scores.evidence: No hard failures in metrics.json: overflowX false, 0 console, mermaid, unknown-block and broken-image errors, and no textOnlyScreens. The s3-diagram flowchart TD has readable Japanese labels at 390 px (pages/mobile-jp-10.png, mobile-jp-11.png). Tables s1-table, s2-table and s4-table fit without sideways scrolling (mobile-jp-04/05/07/13/14). Code blocks practice-setup and practice-answer show 24 and 25 lines with no wraps at 390 px, and highlighted lines 6–12 are clear (mobile-jp-19.png, mobile-jp-25.png).

Every screen has a heading, table, figure, code block or check, and no wall of text appears on any page. The lesson is long, though (33 mobile screens), and the practice section stacks code, six steps, a prompt, a checklist, a hint and two answer code blocks (mobile-jp-18 to mobile-jp-26). Desktop JP measures a median of 42 chars/line against the 30–40 target. That comes from the reader's 680 px measure, not from the lesson.

The UI and content are Japanese throughout, including the diagram labels, table headers and step titles. No stray English UI strings, low-contrast text or controls hidden under the 56/60 px bars. Inline code chips stay whole and readable (mobile-jp-08.png, mobile-jp-12.png). No personal data on any screen: only sample values such as cc-practice-06 and src/api/.

niceToHave: s5-steps / practice-steps: step titles repeat the number. The reader's circled step number 1–6 sits next to a title that starts with ① to ⑥ (pages/mobile-jp-16.png, pages/mobile-jp-20.png). Dropping the ①–⑥ prefix from the titles would remove the double numbering.

practice-checklist: labels show paths and keys as plain bold text ('.env と git push の禁止が、.claude/settings.json の deny にあります'), and on mobile the line breaks awkwardly before 'が、' (pages/mobile-jp-24.png). Shortening the label (for example '.env と git push を deny に入れました') would read better.

lesson.prerequisites: the meta line under the subtitle is a five-line run of small grey text at 390 px (pages/mobile-jp-01.png). Trimming it to the lesson titles, or folding the shell/Git items into one, would lighten the first screen.
reader: desktop JP measure gives a median of 42 chars/line (target 30–40) at a 680 px measure.

reader: the end banner says this is the course's last lesson (draft is not in course.json); the mobile full-length PNG is truncated at 16000 px; failed /api/ requests (500) are ignored environment noise.
summary: The screenshots show the lesson under review (lessonHash sha256:2b49a5e74f15af83). There are no hard failures, privacy problems, cut-off content or unreadable tables, diagrams or code at 390 px, and every screen has a visual anchor. Remaining polish is optional: drop the duplicated ①–⑥ numbering in the step titles and tighten the checklist labels and the prerequisites line.
